label: erk_dual_wavelength_objective_apparatus_evidence_v1
purpose: Apparatus-relevant successor optics contract for future 401-nm erbium in-situ and dispersive-imaging studies. It does not retrospectively alter admitted dissertation result families generated with the legacy NA=0.130, M=10 study design.

source.title: A&L12: Optimised Imaging of Ultracold Quantum Gases
source.institution: Department of Physics, University of Oxford
source.user_supplied_filename: A&L12 MPhys Report Submission Alex McInerny.pdf
source.redistribution_status: local group-supplied evidence; the PDF is not checked into this repository

system_identity.objective_role: dual-wavelength objective for erbium and potassium imaging through the ErK science cell
system_identity.geometry_boundary: The report establishes the objective and science-cell constraints but is not used here to set the probe-wavevector direction relative to the magnetic quantisation axis. That atomic-polarisation geometry remains a separate study input.

prototype.sampling_status_401_nm: undersampled at the 401-nm diffraction limit and for 1-um features

upgraded.sampling_status_401_nm: satisfies the report's Nyquist condition for 1-um features, but not the 0.78-um design diffraction limit

detector_sampling.sampling_boundary: The report supports the magnification and physical pixel scale. It does not define the camera ROI, exposure timing, quantum efficiency, read noise or relay throughput for a non-destructive-imaging sequence.

measured_performance.testbed_status: upgraded objective tested in a setup described as nearly identical to intended experimental use; not an installed-arm calibration

401_nm.fit_model: Gaussian amplitude PSF with the report's 2D-to-1D correction

767_nm.fit_model: Gaussian amplitude PSF with the report's 2D-to-1D correction

aperture_study_401_nm.interpretation: The report attributes the difference from the separately measured 0.92-um optimum to alignment degradation during the aperture sequence. The plateau is an alignment-sensitivity scenario, not a second measurement of the same stable operating point.

measured_performance.field_of_view_status: confirmed significantly larger than 100 um; no tighter measured value is reported

mechanical_and_deployment_limits.small_displacement_repeatability_status: repeatable with backlash compensation when always approached from below
mechanical_and_deployment_limits.large_translation_status: not reproducible enough for reliable time-of-flight operation without further mechanical refinement
mechanical_and_deployment_limits.alignment_status: small external perturbations can degrade near-optimal resolution
mechanical_and_deployment_limits.deployment_claim_boundary: Optical performance meets the stated experimental requirements, but the report does not establish stable installed-arm performance after repeated large translations.

forward_model_policy.legacy_admitted_results: Remain bound to their recorded NA=0.130, M=10 configs and manifests; no retrospective substitution is allowed.
forward_model_policy.future_sampling_default: Use magnification 14.62 and the derived 0.444596443-um object-plane pixel pitch for ErK-objective scenarios.

ideal_design_case.evidence_role: diffraction-limited design upper bound, not measured transfer

measured_best_case.model: Gaussian amplitude-PSF surrogate using the report's equation (5)

alignment_sensitivity_case.model: Gaussian amplitude-PSF surrogate using the report's equation (5)

forward_model_policy.selection_rule: A future retained study must declare which optical-transfer case it uses. Design NA, best measured resolution and aperture-sequence plateau must not be collapsed into one effective parameter.
not_supplied_by_source: probe power, detuning and beam profile
relay throughput and detector quantum efficiency
camera exposure timing, read noise and full-well calibration
installed-arm two-dimensional PSF or complex pupil
